about.title: About the Darkness Ablaze set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Darkness Ablaze is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 14 August 2020. It has 201 cards: 189 in the main set and 12 secret rares. There are also 155 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 189 main set cards), the Master set (344 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 356 cards, adding the 12 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
